retrievalProfile.description: A macro yellow rose against a dreamy, multi-colored bokeh background with centered sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: macro yellow flower with purple blur
retro floral photography with centered text

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, warm yellow rose dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame, set against a soft-focus background of blue, purple, and pink hues. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a dreamlike atmosphere typical of late 1960s soul music covers.
coreVisualRelationships: The yellow rose acts as a warm foreground anchor against a cool-toned background.
The typography is centered horizontally in the upper third of the composition.
The stem of the rose creates a diagonal lead-in from the bottom center.
coreInvariants: Macro yellow rose as the primary subject
Soft-focus bokeh background with blue and purple gradients
Centered sans-serif typography in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The rose is centered and scaled to fill approximately 70% of the lower frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central petals of the rose provide the main focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright yellow rose, moves up to the centered text, and then drifts into the blurred background colors.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image provides breathing room for the title text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow rose petals with lower value, moody tones in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm-to-cool gradient from bottom to top

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the blue background area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist and title for a unified retro look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, compact grotesque feel of the era.
Provides the clean, neutral look required for the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro photograph of a yellow rose with soft, layered petals. The background should be a dreamy, out-of-focus bokeh of deep blue at the top, transitioning into purple and pink mist around the flower.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, uppercase condensed sans-serif text in the upper third of the image. Use a light cyan or mint green color for the text.

verificationChecks: Is the rose the dominant element?
Is the background sufficiently blurred and multi-colored?
Is the text centered and condensed?

mustRedesign: Do not use high-contrast serif fonts
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the blue background
Verify the rose stem is visible at the bottom
Confirm the color palette feels vintage
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro floral subject + dreamy bokeh background + centered condensed sans-serif typography = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
